items.title: Syntomic ring maps are exactly the flat local complete intersections

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies syntomic ring maps with the flat local complete intersections. One direction reduces the global complete intersection presentation to the local condition using the compatibility of the definitions. The other direction is the substance: a local complete intersection is finitely presented because the defining Koszul regular ideal is finitely generated, so it suffices to verify the condition after base change to a field, where the author writes the ring as a quotient of a polynomial ring, uses the definition of a locally Koszul regular ideal to find a local presentation, transports Koszul regularity of the generators through the flat base change to the residue situation, upgrades it to a regular sequence by the finite-module criterion, and then quotes the characterisation of local complete intersections over a field.
